title: Neonyx Idle, a new online Melvor-esqe game coming soon :)
author: Tall-Bicycle5298
selftext:
I've been working on this game for a couple months now and as a lover of the idle MMORPG genre Id figure to take a crack at it myself but with some adjustments to the concept of endgame.

There are 13 skill progressions each with their own Masteries and weapons with their own profiencies so dedicating to a weapon you like does pay off in the long run.

https://preview.redd.it/us2zxdq6p9lh1.png?width=1558&format=png&auto=webp&s=741cfea5417191ab5dde4994d22fce3487490f55

Players can get keys from different sources which they can use to gain access to dungeons which is a 5 stage fight sequence with hidden surprises that may give something of value and some that may cost you the run if you're not prepared  


https://preview.redd.it/jz8b02hop9lh1.png?width=1623&format=png&auto=webp&s=b630fc6ee251dcdbe6c5b45949e781c946567e68

Faction development is a long-term investment to enhance member strength and faction utility as a  whole. 

https://preview.redd.it/ircde1rft9lh1.png?width=1639&format=png&auto=webp&s=0d44a565bf7dee6d4c7ea4dcf12b736cad1fba4a

This one is a bit of a marathon like Melvor but I added PvP elements that's entirely OPTIONAL:

Duels  - 1v1

Territory Wars - (up to) 4v4

Warring for territories provides opportunities to obtain small buffs for the faction as a whole. I've about gotten the auto-defense system operational where the Faction leader can select members to defend a territory in the event an opposing faction tries to take it from them while they are offline. I tried to include as much detail here about how it functions without getting too wordy, but if a player who is selected to defend a territory is online, their offline snapshot won't partake in a war.

https://preview.redd.it/r81r9n5av9lh1.png?width=784&format=png&auto=webp&s=d4a477d0746970708221329caeed81adcd29a29d

There is still some balance I'm working on with PvP and the current iteration is the closest I'm at where the fighting feels comfortable with the weapon effects. Yes, weapons have their own unique effects to spice up the fighting some :) Tried to give each weapon their own identity which is still being adjusted here and there.

There will be no advertisements for increases/buffs of any kind.

The current UI is still in the works and will continue to improve by the day as I nitpick and optimize.

https://preview.redd.it/d6qneimc0alh1.png?width=1856&format=png&auto=webp&s=51d5d4154d4688ac3efc191149d340c8be69438b

There is already a roadmap in place, and the next major expansion is underway, which will give more functionality to owning territory, like a Smuggling route which is a sequence events of a faction moving caches through the city map and Excavating a dilapidated building. There are 20(1 for each territory) planned in the coming expansion but that won't be for months as I continue to work on and improve the infrastructure of what's already present. Those events that I mentioned are things that are going to be ran by the owning faction and not run on a system scheduled deadline.

I also have some lore in place that's being developed, and I'm creating a system that will give players the opportunity to shape the game's story and influence later content via an item called the 'Neonyx Codex' This is largely the shape of the player-driven lore where players can make posts about things and certain events which can ultimately become canonized. This of course runs through a moderated system before approval so anyone just spamming their keyboard or being malicious towards the community doesn't reach the public.  

As of right now, the game is in WebView form so only accessible via a browser. I'm intending for this to be available on Steam, Android and iOS relatively soon hopefully within the next few days. :)

**Ai disclosures:** All art used was generated via Ai. I do have a concept artist, and she is handling some background art. The art is then upscaled via Ai to match the theme, with her permission. I use Claude to assist in finding holes in the game loop like items that don't feed into a recipe or no longer drops due to an item shuffle.

*Also, for those who aren't privy to guns, as there is gun art. I included a toggle that changes the guns to bows/hand crossbows and the bullets to arrows.*

This is a passion project and I intend to make a slew of cosmetics down the line like changing out your combat cards (the thing that states your name during combat) and allowing that to be swapped out for a 2d sprite. In the works too, and something entirely in its early alpha stages.

comments.author: LordKwik
comments.body:

can't wait to hear more about it! I used to play Melvor during working hours, and then at home in the background, until they got bought out lol

best of luck!

replies.author: Tall-Bicycle5298
replies.body:
Woo! Definitely loved reading this, ahah. Little boost to my confidence :) 

the beta players i have now in the game are liking it too especially as they are trying out different builds and weapon combinations. Right now they are testing out the Synth Gloves [mage equivalent] which utilizes 1 of 3 elements which come with its own status effects.

Unlike Melvor, I doubt CD project red will buy this despite it being cyberpunk themed  😆
